# fjordrun_environment_services (Data Source)

The services of an environment, as they are in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_environment_services" "production" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}

output "hostnames" {
  value = { for s in data.fjordrun_environment_services.production.services : s.name => s.private_hostname }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
